dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple high-contrast 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible along the dorsal-lateral axis, characterized by thin light-intensity borders enclosing dark centers with abrupt pixel-level gradient transitions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid high-intensity clusters; high-value pixels are predominantly distributed as curvilinear segments forming the edges of the annular patterns rather than as isolated solid blobs.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent annular rings located on the mid-dorsal region form a scalene triangle with the longest side oriented parallel to the animal's spinal column.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex, labyrinthine reticulation of light-colored lines forms a dense mesh-like topology on the anterior dorsal section, becoming more fragmented and circular toward the posterior.
